avis.titre: Nice at first, but now it triggers dermatitis.
avis.texte: This brand was recommended by my dermatologist. I liked the thin consistency of this gel (which soaks into skin far more easily than creams). It didn't brighten the skin around my eyes as advertised, but the hydration helped my wrinkles not look nearly as pronounced. I used the gel every-other-day (3-4 days a week) in the evenings. To use, I'd wash my face and hands, dispense one pump onto the back of my hand, and dab the gel along my orbital bone with my ring finger. This worked fine for a while, but recently I seem to have developed an allergy to the product. I woke up the other day to see a cluster of tiny bumps on the back of my hand (in the same spot where I dispense the gel). I looked in the mirror and my eyes (the lids of which were pink and puffy), were ringed by clusters of the same tiny bumps. My routine is extremely minimal, and this gel is the only product I dispense on the back of my hand or use near my eyes, so I know this product is the culprit. I spoke with my dermatologist, who says it's not uncommon to develop an allergic reaction to something you've successfully used without issue before (especially if you have sensitive skin) and advised me to throw out the remainder of the product. I'm pretty bummed, as I did really like it initially. While my hand has cleared up and most of the redness and swelling around my eyes is gone, I still have clusters of bumps on my crow's feet. Hopefully they fade soon - they make the skin around my eyes look sun damaged! :(

avis.titre: One of the rare products that works for me
avis.texte: I'm almost 70. My eyelids now have droopy hoods. I've tried several eye creams, eye retinol, etc. Nothing. I didn't expect much from this. Hyaluronic acid never does anything for me and I doubted volcanic water could do what other creams couldn't. I just bought it to get free shipping and a free sample. Whatever it is in this product, the HA, the volcanic water or the gel like consistency, it actually made a noticeable difference in my eyes, especially the droopiest right eye. Always skeptical, I at first assumed it was a passing thing having to do with hydration or sleep position. However, it's worked every day. Some days a little more lid than others, but always visible lid, whereas before using this I was completely hooded on my right eye. It did take a few days to a week before I noticed it. (You can tell how much I anticipated the result by the fact that I didn't even think about it.) I just happened one day to realize, "Hey. I think my eyes are better." And I waited another week before I'd believe that the stuff was actually working. I now always have a spare bottle. I never want to run out. The Lift-Activ HA does nothing for my face or sagging. This Mineral 89 Eye Gel, however, is one of maybe 3 products that have ever made a noticeable difference. After all of this, my caveat is that just because it worked for me doesn't mean it will for you. But this is a subjective review of my own experience. I hope that it's the same for anyone reading this! I use it morning and n

avis.titre: a pleasant surprise and a new "can't do without"  product
avis.texte: I bought this only for the purpose of adding another product to get free shipping and a free sample. This fit the bill and the reviews were good. However, being a confirmed skin care pessimist by long experience I expected little, if anything. I like the gel like texture. It has no scent that I can detect. Doesn't irritate my skin at all. Glides on smoothly. Perhaps a trifle tacky initially, but that may be what I think is part of my satisfaction. I have some sagging hoods on my upper eyelids. A few days after using this I realized that I could see more of my eyelids. I attributed it to a simple fluke. However, it remained consistent and my eyes reverted to sagging when I stopped using it. Using it at night helps, but the result of mashing my face in the pillow (I can't seem to remain on my back because of nose stuffines) reduces the effect. Still, first thing in the morning is better than it used to be. However, there is a definite and significant improvement during the day. If I put this on in the morning, by the time I notice myself again a few hours later the eyelid has obviously perked up. I don't know if it's the gel texture that tightens things, or the hyaluronic acid in the gel (other HAs haven't worked for me), but it works. Based on other reviews, this obviously isn't happening for everyone. But, it is definitely helping me. Even if it's temporary, I'll take it! This is now added to the exceedingly short list of products that I've found effective and won't do withou
